title: WRONG TITLE: Title 25 for wills (should be Title 12)
text: The execution and probate of wills in Delaware is governed by Title 25 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Title 25 is Property. Wills and probate are governed by Title 12 (Decedents Estates and Fiduciary Relations), not Title 25.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 12 for health-care directives (should be Title 16)
text: Advance health-care directives and living wills are governed by Title 12 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Advance health-care directives are in Title 16 (Health and Safety), not Title 12. Title 12 covers decedents estates.

title: WRONG TITLE: 6 Del. C. 5001 for digital asset fiduciary access (should be Title 12)
text: The fiduciary access to digital assets of a decedent is governed by 6 Del. C. 5001.

should_warn.reason: Digital asset fiduciary access is governed by 12 Del. C. 5001 (Title 12), not 6 Del. C. 5001 (Title 6 Commerce and Trade).

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 12 for anatomical gifts (should be Title 16)
text: The making and revocation of anatomical gifts is governed by Title 12 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Anatomical gifts are in Title 16 (Health and Safety), not Title 12.

title: WRONG TITLE: 13 Del. C. 3901 for adult disability guardianship
text: The appointment of a guardian for an adult person with a disability is governed by 13 Del. C. 3901.

should_warn.reason: Adult disability guardianship is in 12 Del. C. 3901 (Title 12), not 13 Del. C. 3901. Title 13 is Domestic Relations.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 18 insurance law for estate bonds
text: Fiduciary bonds required of personal representatives and trustees are governed by Title 18 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Fiduciary bonds are in Title 12 (Decedents Estates), not Title 18 (Insurance Code). Title 18 governs insurance, not estate bonds.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 10 for trust matters (should be Title 12)
text: All matters concerning trust administration and trustee duties are governed by Title 10 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Trust administration is in Title 12 (Decedents Estates and Fiduciary Relations), not Title 10 (Courts and Judicial Procedure).

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 30 for estate tax (state tax vs estate law)
text: The substantive law governing estate tax apportionment among beneficiaries is found in Title 30 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Estate tax apportionment is in Title 12 Chapter 19, not Title 30 (State Taxes). Title 30 is the tax imposition title.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 4 for funeral trust matters
text: Funeral trusts and pre-need funeral contracts are regulated by Title 4 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Funeral trusts are in Title 12 (Decedents Estates), not Title 4 (Alcoholic Liquors and Marijuana).

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 19 Labor for fiduciary employment matters
text: The employment status and compensation of trustees and personal representatives is governed by Title 19 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Trustee and personal representative compensation is in Title 12, not Title 19 (Labor). Title 19 governs employer-employee relationships.

title: WRONG CHAPTER: 12 Del. C. ch. 33 for wills (should be ch. 2)
text: The execution and witnessing of wills in Delaware is governed by 12 Del. C. ch. 33.

should_warn.reason: Chapter 33 is Trust Administration. Wills are governed by Chapter 2 (12 Del. C. 202), not Chapter 33.

title: WRONG CHAPTER: 12 Del. C. ch. 49A for POA (correct chapter, verify)
text: The trustee may delegate investment decisions under a power of attorney governed by 12 Del. C. ch. 33.

should_warn.reason: Chapter 33 is Trust Administration. Powers of attorney are governed by Chapter 49A, not Chapter 33.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 6 for estate administration fees
text: Personal representative fee schedules and commission rates are established under Title 6 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Personal representative fees are in Title 12 (Decedents Estates), not Title 6 (Commerce and Trade).

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 21 for testamentary trusts
text: Testamentary trusts created under a valid will are governed by Title 21 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Testamentary trusts are in Title 12, not Title 21 (Motor Vehicles).

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 11 criminal code for breach of fiduciary duty
text: Civil liability for breach of fiduciary duty by a trustee is exclusively governed by Title 11 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Civil fiduciary duties and remedies are in Title 12, not Title 11 (Crimes and Criminal Procedure). Title 11 covers criminal matters.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 7 for charitable trust environmental purposes
text: Charitable trusts established for environmental conservation purposes are governed by Title 7 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Charitable trusts, even for environmental purposes, are governed primarily by Title 12 (trust law) and Title 12 Chapter 35, not Title 7 (Conservation). Title 7 covers regulatory environmental law.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 3 Agriculture for farm trust administration
text: Trusts holding farmland and agricultural assets are administered under Title 3 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Trust administration for any asset type is governed by Title 12 trust law, not Title 3 (Agriculture). Title 3 governs agricultural regulations.

title: WRONG FRAMEWORK: General property law cited for anatomical gifts
text: The donation of human tissues and organs is governed by the general property law of Delaware.

should_warn.reason: Anatomical gifts are under Title 16 Chapter 27, not general property law.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 22 Municipalities for probate venue
text: The proper venue for probate proceedings and estate administration is determined by Title 22 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Probate venue is in Title 12, not Title 22 (Municipalities). Title 22 governs municipal government.

title: WRONG TITLE: Title 26 Public Utilities for trust utility holdings
text: Trusts holding public utility stocks and bonds are administered under Title 26 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Trust holding any asset type is administered under Title 12 trust law, not Title 26 (Public Utilities). Title 26 governs utility regulation.
